author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಆರೈಸು ಹಿರಿಕಿರಿಯ ಜೀವಗಳ ಸಂತತವು
ಹಾರೈಸಿ ಹರಸುವರು ನಿನ್ನ ಏಳಿಗೆಗೆ
ಕೋರೈಸಿ ಸೆಳೆಯುತಿರೆ ಅನಗತ್ಯ ವಿಷಯಗಳು
ಮಾರೈದು ದೂರವಿರು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Always care for the lives around you, old and young;
they will wish you well and bless your rise;
when needless things dazzle and pull you in,
stay a good five miles away, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Look after the elderly and the young, and their blessings will help you grow. Keep well clear of glittering distractions.
